audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicts its own explanations: win[] gives Aatrox Levels 1-2 and Skill at 3, while whys[0] and whys[1] say the level is even and whys[2] says Aatrox takes over at 3. full phases[].side repeats the disagreement, and phases[6].side says Galio while content win[6] and the prose both say it evens out.
audit.why: At levels 1-2 Aatrox has one Darkin Blade cast (14s at rank 1) and no Infernal Chains; Galio has Winds of War at 825 range for 60 mana. Neither can kill. Aatrox's lead starts at 3, when the third-swing knock-up feeds Infernal Chains - exactly what the existing prose argues.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-2 Skill, Level 3 Aatrox, Levels 4-5 / 6 / first item Aatrox, 2+ items Skill - chart aligned to the prose in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text names Eclipse/Goredrinker, and the full-layer phases at Levels 1, 2 and 3 all tell the player to trade when World Ender is down - World Ender does not exist until level 6.
audit.why: World Ender is 120/100/80s and unlocks at 6. Tracking it at level 1 is unusable advice; the real early cooldowns are Infernal Chains 20s at rank 1 and Umbral Dash 9s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Early phases now key off Infernal Chains (20s) and Umbral Dash (9s); level 6 and first item key off World Ender (120s at rank 1) and the anti-heal buy.

audit.whatIsWrong: The pages repeatedly claim Shield of Durand's magic-tilted reduction does nothing because Aatrox is physical, and never state the one part of his kit it does blunt. Anti-heal is absent from the content layer entirely despite three healing sources.
audit.why: Deathbringer Stance deals bonus magic damage and heals off the target's max health, so the bonus magic reduction does bite that auto; The Darkin Blade is physical. Aatrox heals from Deathbringer Stance, from Umbral Dash's passive on any champion damage, and World Ender increases his healing - Grievous Wounds changes the trade maths, not more MR.
audit.corrected: Stated the split (only Deathbringer Stance is magic) and put Oblivion Orb into the content layer's mid and first-item text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The early text says his passive heals on every on-hit.
audit.why: Deathbringer Stance is periodic - Riot's text reads 'Periodically, Aatrox's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage and heals him'. The heal that applies to every instance of champion damage is Umbral Dash's passive, a different ability.
audit.corrected: Separated the two heal sources by name in the early text.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gave no numbers at all.
audit.why: Infernal Chains at 20s rank 1 is his longest early cooldown and the actual trade window.
audit.corrected: Numbers added for World Ender, Infernal Chains, Shield of Durand and Hero's Entrance.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization left boots as 'Plated Steelcaps / Sorcerer's Shoes' with no reason given.
audit.why: The Darkin Blade, his autos and the World Ender AD are physical; only Deathbringer Stance is magic. Steelcaps is the answer.
audit.corrected: Boot choice made explicit and tied to the damage split.

edits.before: Aatrox is genuinely weak levels 1-2 with only a single Q charge and no chain to lock you, so contest the opening wave instead of conceding it — but never trade autos, his passive heals on every on-hit and he wins any extended exchange. Poke with the center column of Winds of War from max range and sidestep his third-cast Q edge, since that knock-up is what sets up his W chain-pull. At level 3 you finally have a punish: if he walks up to last-hit, ramp Shield of Durand to tank the hit, release the taunt, and Justice Punch out — that fixed-distance dash repositions you and is your only respectable trading window before he scales.
edits.after: Aatrox is genuinely weak levels 1-2 with one Darkin Blade cast and no chain to lock you, so contest the opening wave instead of conceding it — but never trade autos: Deathbringer Stance periodically empowers an auto that heals him off your max health, and Umbral Dash's passive heals him whenever he damages you. Poke with the center column of Winds of War from its full 825 range and sidestep his third swing, since that knock-up is what sets up Infernal Chains. At level 3 you finally have a punish: if he steps up to last-hit, ramp Shield of Durand to tank the hit, release the taunt, and Justice Punch out — 650 range on an 11s cooldown, and your only real window before he scales.

edits.before: This is where Aatrox takes over. Once all his Q charges and his auto-weave are online, his on-hit heal and W chain-pull out-sustain everything you do — never sit in a prolonged trade, and don't lean on Shield of Durand's damage reduction because it's amplified against magic and his whole kit is physical. Your one answer at 6 is Hero's Entrance: even losing the 1v1, flag-drop into mid or bot and convert your lane loss into two kills elsewhere. If he all-ins you, ramp the W to bait out his R commitment, taunt him, Justice Punch away — do not try to out-duel him once his ultimate combat stats are live.
edits.after: This is where Aatrox takes over. Once all three Darkin Blade swings and his auto-weave are online, Umbral Dash's heal and Infernal Chains out-sustain everything you do — never sit in a prolonged trade, and don't lean on Shield of Durand's reduction, because only Deathbringer Stance is magic damage. Infernal Chains is 20s at rank 1, so that gap is your trade window and Oblivion Orb is what makes the trade stick. Your one answer at 6 is Hero's Entrance: even losing the 1v1, flag-drop into mid or bot and convert your lane loss into two kills elsewhere instead of duelling World Ender.
